Expense Policy
Rules for business travel, meals, conveyance, client entertainment and expense reimbursement

Version

Document
owner

Effective date
1 January 2026
Applies to
All employees (limits vary by grade G1 to
G6)
Classification
Internal - Confidential
Abstract. This policy explains which business expenses Nexora reimburses, the limits that apply by employee grade, and
how claims are submitted, approved and paid. It covers domestic and international travel, accommodation, per diem
allowances, local conveyance, client entertainment and travel advances. Claims must be submitted within 15 calendar days
with valid receipts; non-compliant claims are returned or rejected. All amounts are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) unless stated.
Keywords: expense policy, reimbursement, travel, per diem, hotel limit, receipts, travel advance, approval
1. Principles
• Spend company money as carefully as your own; choose the reasonable option, not the most expensive
one.
• Expenses must be business-related, reasonable, documented and approved according to this policy.
• Employees are responsible for the accuracy of their claims. False claims are gross misconduct under the
Employee Handbook (NX-HR-002).
• Grades (G1 to G6) are defined in the Employee Handbook.

3. Business Travel
3.1 Per Diem and Accommodation
For overnight travel within Pakistan, employees receive a fixed daily allowance for meals and incidental costs,
and hotel stays are reimbursed up to the nightly cap. The caps apply in Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad; in other
cities the hotel cap is 70% of the amount shown. Figure 1 compares the limits by grade.

3.2 International Travel
International trips need approval from the department head and the CFO office at least 14 days before
departure. Per diem is paid in US dollars: USD 75 for G1 to G3, USD 100 for G4, USD 125 for G5 and USD 150
for G6. Hotels are booked through the approved travel desk within a per-night budget agreed at approval.
Employees must hold valid travel insurance, which the company arranges.
3.3 Travel Advances
An advance of up to 80% of the estimated trip cost can be requested at least 5 working days before travel. The
advance must be settled with receipts within 7 days of return; unsettled advances are recovered from the next
salary.
4. Claim Submission and Approval
All claims are submitted in the Expense portal within 15 calendar days of the expense (or of return from travel).
Claims submitted later require the CFO office's exception approval. A receipt or tax invoice is mandatory for any
expense above PKR 500; for smaller amounts a signed self-declaration is accepted up to PKR 3,000 per month.

5. Non-Reimbursable Expenses
• Traffic fines, parking penalties and vehicle repairs; alcohol or any prohibited item; personal shopping,
entertainment or gifts.
• Travel of family members, upgrades not covered by policy, and minibar or laundry charges on trips shorter
than 5 days.
• Expenses already paid through the company card, procurement or the learning allowance (no double
claims).
• Expenses without a receipt above PKR 500.
6. Audit and Non-Compliance
Finance audits at least 10% of claims each quarter. Duplicate or falsified claims will be recovered in full and
reported to HR; repeated late submissions may lead to a claim being held for approval by the department head.
7. References
[1] Nexora Employee Handbook, NX-HR-002 (grades and conduct).
[2] Nexora Benefits Guide, NX-HR-003 (allowances).
[3] Nexora Procurement Policy, NX-FIN-002.
[4] Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 (Pakistan): withholding and allowable business expenses.
